tours.name: Cash Sales Order
tours.description: Step-by-step guide to selling to a cash customer: create the quotation, confirm it, deliver the goods, invoice the customer and record the cash payment.

steps.title: Open the Sales app
steps.content: From the Odoo home screen, click the **Sales** app.

steps.title: Go to Orders
steps.content: In the top menu, click **Orders** to see the order options.

steps.title: Open Quotations
steps.content: Click **Quotations** to see the list of existing quotations.

steps.title: Create a new quotation
steps.content: Click the **New** button at the top left to start a blank quotation.

steps.title: Search for the customer
steps.content: Click the **Customer** field and type the customer name (for example "abc"). Matching customers appear in a list.

steps.title: Choose the customer
steps.content: Click the correct customer in the list to select them.

steps.title: Set the payment type to Cash
steps.content: In **Order Payment Type**, choose **Cash**, because the customer pays on the spot.

steps.title: Set the quotation type
steps.content: In **Quotation Type**, choose **Sales**.

steps.title: Add a product line
steps.content: Under the order lines, click **Add a product** to add a new row.

steps.title: Search for the product
steps.content: In the new row, type the product name or code (for example "02BB 023").

steps.title: Choose the product
steps.content: Click the product in the list, for example **[02BB 023] BALL BEARING 6202-2RS**.

steps.title: Check the quantity
steps.content: Click the **Quantity** cell. It starts at 1. Type a different number if the customer is buying more.

steps.title: Open the Other Info tab
steps.content: Click the **Other Info** tab to fill in payment, team and warehouse details.

steps.title: Open Payment Terms
steps.content: Click the **Payment Terms** field. A list of payment terms appears.

steps.title: Choose Immediate Payment
steps.content: Select **Immediate Payment**. Cash orders are paid straight away, so do not use terms such as "90 Days".

steps.title: Open Sales Team
steps.content: Click the **Sales Team** field. If your team is not in the short list, use "Search More..." in the next step.

steps.title: Search for more teams
steps.content: Click **Search More...** at the bottom of the list to see all sales teams.

steps.title: Choose your sales team
steps.content: Click your team, for example **Colombo Sales Centre**.

steps.title: Open Warehouse
steps.content: Click the **Warehouse** field to choose where the goods will be shipped from.

steps.title: Search for more warehouses
steps.content: Click **Search More...** to see all warehouses.

steps.title: Choose the warehouse
steps.content: Click the warehouse, for example **JAM Warehouse Ekala- (JM-EK)**.

steps.title: Confirm the order
steps.content: Click **Confirm**. The quotation becomes a confirmed Sales Order.

steps.title: Open the delivery
steps.content: Click the **Delivery** button at the top of the order to open the delivery document.

steps.title: Validate the delivery
steps.content: Click **Validate** to confirm the goods have been handed over to the customer.

steps.title: Go back to the order
steps.content: Click the order number (for example **S01881**) at the top to return to the sales order.

steps.title: Start the invoice
steps.content: Click **Create Invoice** to begin billing the customer.

steps.title: Create the invoice
steps.content: In the window that opens, click **Create Invoice** again to confirm.

steps.title: Check the linked order
steps.content: Click the **Sale Orders** button on the invoice to confirm it is linked to your order.

steps.title: Open the invoice
steps.content: Back on the order, click the **Invoices** button to open the invoice.

steps.title: Register the payment
steps.content: On the invoice, click **Register Payment** to record the cash received.

steps.title: Choose the journal
steps.content: Click the **Journal** field to choose where the payment is recorded.

steps.title: Search for more journals
steps.content: Click **Search More...** to see all journals.

steps.title: Choose the cash journal
steps.content: Select **Customer Receipts - Cash**.

steps.title: Create the payment
steps.content: Click **Create Payment** to finish. The invoice is now paid.

steps.title: Return to the order
steps.content: Click the **Sale Orders** button to go back to the sales order.

steps.title: Open the invoice again
steps.content: Click the **Invoices** button to view the invoice one last time.

steps.title: Done — the invoice is paid
steps.content: The invoice shows the green **In Payment** ribbon. The cash sale is complete.
